patch_description:
After the skip-3 CZ layer, append a second complete pass of the three-block entanglement sequence (nearest-neighbor XX → offset YY → long-range CRZ), reusing the same three parameters: "ent_nn", "ent_off", and "ent_lr".

This doubles the efficient seven-gate motif while maintaining complete parameter sharing. The motivation is to improve worst_group_margin (currently 0.35, the bottleneck), which requires stronger discrimination of hard samples. The second pass adds expressive power without introducing new parameters, thus maintaining parameter efficiency while enriching the circuit's ability to separate difficult validation groups.
